PROJECT: 'SHK Islam' - Arabic-first Islamic platform (RTL, lang=ar dir=rtl) for preachers/khatibs/students. Next.js 16 App Router + Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui + next-themes (light/dark). The AI chat assistant is THE product: answers Islamic questions, cites Quran ayahs and hadiths via tool calls. REDESIGN GOAL: ChatGPT-style chat-first app. `/` = chat page. A collapsible sidebar holds the other pages (Quran browser, Hadith browser, Themes, Favorites, Search, About).

YOUR AESTHETIC SEED: deep ink-emerald and gold-leaf illumination, aged parchment panels, scholarly heritage luxury. Think a gilded Quranic manuscript binding: dark emerald leather, gold tooling, cream parchment for content surfaces, calligraphic flourishes. This direction is ALLOWED to use gold (it's intentional heritage, not cliché). The chat should feel like writing in a scholar's illuminated notebook. Ayah/hadith citations render as gold-ruled parchment callouts.

GROUND RULES (non-negotiable): Zero em-dashes (— or –) in any copy/docs, use hyphen. Exactly ONE accent color (gold counts as the single accent). One corner-radius system. min-h-[100dvh] never h-screen. RTL first: in dir=rtl the sidebar sits on the RIGHT visually (use the 'start' side). Calm motion: transform/opacity only, prefers-reduced-motion honored, no scroll-hijack, max one marquee. No AI-purple gradients. Tajawal stays as Arabic UI font (can propose a display pairing but must stay Arabic-first RTL). Recommend zero new dependencies.

DESIGN.md must contain, in order: (1) One-line Design Read, (2) 3-4 sentence concept narrative, (3) exact palette (light AND dark) with concrete color values for background, surface, primary accent, secondary, text, borders, (4) typography plan reusing Tajawal + optional display font swap, (5) full layout system: chat shell wireframe (ASCII), collapsible sidebar treatment, and how each other page inherits it, (6) component inventory: chat input, message bubbles, tool callouts, sidebar nav items, empty state, (7) motion spec, (8) corner radius + surface system, (9) 3 signature premium details unique to this direction, (10) anti-slop self-audit checklist confirming every ground rule.

Be opinionated and specific. Concrete values, not vibes. This is a real spec another engineer will implement.
